title: Design System: Lico Arc Protocol Documentation

display.purpose: Root and chapter titles with compact technical authority.

body.purpose: Long-form protocol explanation at a maximum 72ch measure.

label.purpose: Protocol identifiers, state values, code, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: search-float
shadows.purpose: Separates the open search results from the reading surface.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color, border, and background feedback on interactive controls; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main reading or source action.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:2.65rem; padding:.55rem .9rem; border:1px solid #67d6ff; border-radius:.45rem; background:#67d6ff; color:#061017; font:750 .88rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#9ae5ff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67d6ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Quiet Action
components.css: .ds-quiet { min-height:2.35rem; padding:.45rem .7rem; border:1px solid #27313d; border-radius:.45rem; background:#11161d; color:#edf3f8; font:650 .82rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color:#748191; background:#161d26; } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67d6ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search { width:22rem; height:2.5rem; padding:0 .9rem; border:1px solid #27313d; border-radius:.625rem; background:#11161d; color:#edf3f8; font:1rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color:#748191; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67d6ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Current Chapter
components.description: Selected state in the desktop chapter rail.
components.css: .ds-current { display:block; padding:.38rem .55rem; border-radius:.35rem; background:#102a35; color:#9ae5ff; font:680 .86rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-current:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67d6ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Lifecycle Status
components.description: A compact protocol dimension with a literal state value.
components.css: .ds-status { padding:1rem; border-block:1px solid #27313d; background:#090b0e; color:#edf3f8; } .ds-status span,.ds-status strong { display:block; } .ds-status span { color:#748191; font:700 .72rem/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-status strong { margin-top:.15rem; color:#77deb2; font:700 .91rem/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; }

narrative.overview: The interface treats the protocol as something a developer can inspect, traverse, and verify. Dark tonal layers create a quiet working surface while cyan marks only focus, links, and current position. Dense navigation and narrow prose keep the experience familiar to readers of open technical protocols.
keyCharacteristics: Dark on first paint, with an explicit persistent light option.
Hairline structure and tonal layers instead of decorative depth.
A fixed desktop chapter rail and native mobile disclosure.
Source wayfinding beside every material protocol subject.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies interaction, focus, and source wayfinding; it does not decorate passive regions.

rules.name: The Technical Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates literal protocol data; it is never used as atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Static documentation regions use tone or a divider, never both a border and shadow.

dos: Do keep the complete documentation hierarchy usable without JavaScript.
Do attach protocol summaries to public canonical source links.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and bounded reading measure.
donts: Don't use glow, illustration, gradients, or promotional cards.
Don't imply Candidate source is published, certified, or operational.
Don't use cyan as ambient decoration.
